description: This file defines FastAPI API endpoints for managing comments on work items within a project management backend. It includes data models for comments, functions to list and add comments, and internal utilities for user identification via Supabase authentication.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a single comment attached to a work item, including metadata such as author information and timestamps.

classes.name: CreateCommentRequest
classes.description: Data model for the payload when creating a new comment, ensuring non-empty content.

methods.name: SupabaseClient get_supabase(settings=Depends(get_settings))
methods.description: Provides a configured Supabase client based on application settings.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _resolve_user_from_bearer_token( supabase: SupabaseClient, authorization: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Resolves user ID and display name from a provided Bearer token via Supabase authentication and fallback user profile lookup.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all comments for a specified work item, ordered by creation time.

methods.name: Comment add_comment( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), payload: CreateCommentRequest = ..., supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"), )
methods.description: API endpoint to add a new comment to a work item, associating it with the author extracted from the auth token.
